services.desc: Drawn to Create explores how artists use the elements and principles of art to create meaningful compositions, featuring works from the Rutgers-Camden Collection of Art. Visitors can explore, participate in hands-on activities, and create their own artwork. The Thesis Exhibition: ART CAN highlights the perspective that art is more than just physical objects or academic disciplines. Art has the potential to enhance our understanding, reshape our perceptions, and convey meaning in ways that resonate deeply. We look forward to welcoming you to this celebration of creativity and talent. Of the People features a selection of works on paper by contemporary artists from across the United States
